description: This file contains implementation for handling HTTP headers in the curl library, including functions for parsing, storing, and retrieving HTTP headers, as well as header API functions.

methods.name: void copy_header_external(struct Curl_header_store * hs,size_t index,size_t amount,struct Curl_llist_element * e,struct curl_header * hout)
methods.description: Copies header data from internal storage to an output structure, setting all struct fields appropriately.

methods.name: CURLHcode curl_easy_header(CURL * easy,const char * name,size_t index,unsigned int origin,int request,struct curl_header ** hout)
methods.description: Public API function to retrieve a specific header matching the name, index, and type.

methods.name: struct:curl_header * curl_easy_nextheader(CURL * easy,unsigned int type,int request,struct curl_header * prev)
methods.description: Public API to iterate over headers matching specified criteria.

methods.name: CURLcode namevalue(char * header,size_t hlen,unsigned int type,char ** name,char ** value)
methods.description: Parses a header line into name and value parts.

methods.name: CURLcode unfold_value(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * value,size_t vlen)
methods.description: Handles folded header lines by appending continuation lines to previous header value.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_headers_push(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * header,unsigned char type)
methods.description: Stores a full HTTP header line, parsing and inserting it into internal structures.

methods.name: void headers_reset(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Resets the header list and internal state.

methods.name: CURLcode hds_cw_collect_write(struct Curl_easy * data,struct Curl_cwriter * writer,int type,const char * buf,size_t blen)
methods.description: Writes header data during collection and stores headers if appropriate.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_headers_init(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Initializes header handling structures for a given easy handle.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_headers_cleanup(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Frees all stored header data and resets related structures.

methods.name: CURLHcode curl_easy_header(CURL * easy,const char * name,size_t nameindex,unsigned int type,int request,struct curl_header ** hout)
